integrity: A symbolic all-parameter proof and finite exact-rational verification are included. A published forward formula is used as an acknowledged theorem. The analysis is a same-model review without independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Only positively weighted, edge-labeled two-vertex n-parallel-edge metric graphs with n>=3 and connected free double covers, with a formal zero at the disconnected class. The forward Prym volume formula is explicitly prior work. Unlabeled-cover data, arbitrary graphs, ramification, independent validation and historical priority are not established.
title: Fourier recognition and Torelli recovery from Prym-volume profiles of banana curves
